{{Quote|This vicious Sand People tribe is rallying for a major assault--to destroy our village and anything else they come across.''"<br />"''But instead, we'll destroy their tribe, stop the spread of Bloodgouge's influence and revel in glory!|Dorrick and Gezda|<ref name="TOR:BaS" />}}
'''Gezda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|warrior]] residing in [[Outpost Rennar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. When the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] chief [[Bloodgouge]] made plans to destroy Outpost Rennar, Gezda and [[Dorrick]] offered Imperial spacers a chance take the tribe out by assaulting [[Bloodgouge's Lair]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="TOR:BaS" />
